A private chauffeur for professionals — book by the hour, for a full-day standby, or for airport pickups, roadshows and meetings in Riyadh, Jeddah, or Dammam.

Private chauffeur and executive transport in Saudi Arabia means a professional chauffeur and a private car booked by the hour, half-day or full day for meetings, airport transfers and city travel in Riyadh, Jeddah and Dammam, with the fare agreed before booking.

What is a private chauffeur service in Saudi Arabia?

It is a private car with a professional chauffeur booked in advance for a block of hours or a whole day, rather than a single point-to-point ride. The car waits outside each stop, and the fare is agreed before you book. Single airport or intercity runs are covered on the airport transfers page.

Hourly hire or a full day: which should I book?

Book by the hour when you have a few stops and a known end time, and a full day when meetings may overrun or you are hosting a visitor. A single transfer is simpler when you only need A to B, so say honestly which fits when you send the details. Vehicle categories are listed on the fleet page, and the pricing page explains how fares are quoted.

Where can I book an executive chauffeur?

In Riyadh, Jeddah and Dammam through our partner network. City details are on the Riyadh and Jeddah driver-by-the-hour pages, and companies setting up regular travel can see corporate transport or contact us.

Booking for a company or a visiting team?

Email your cities, dates and passenger numbers and we reply with a written quote. Corporate invoicing can be arranged through our sister company.

  • Written quote by email

Frequently Asked Questions

Can I book a private chauffeur by the hour?

Yes. You can book a private chauffeur by the hour, for a half-day, or for a full day — the vehicle and driver stay dedicated to you between stops.

Can I book a chauffeur for a full day of meetings?

Yes. We offer hourly and full-day executive charter where your chauffeur stays on standby between meetings across the city.

Do you provide invoices for corporate expense claims?

Yes. Corporate invoicing can be arranged through our sister company.

Can I work or take calls during the trip?

Yes — it is a private car with a professional chauffeur, so you can take calls or review documents between stops. Tell us your schedule when you request the quote and we confirm the vehicle.

Can I book a chauffeur in Jeddah, Riyadh or Dammam?

Yes. Chauffeur hire is available in all three cities through our partner network, by the hour, half-day or full day, with the fare agreed before booking. Send the date, start time and hours needed.
